detail.longDescription: Claude Run is now public. Run `claude --print` to automate tasks. Works with # YouTrack # Forgejo and # github . - The `youtrack` action queries YouTrack for work, clones the repo (pulled from YouTrack VCS settings), write the code and submits a PR. - Automerge will monitor the PR and merge it when all checks pass. - Webhook triage will analyze failed CI runs. - Webhook comment acts on `/claude` messages, providing easy # mergeconflict resolution, # codereview etc. Claude Run is best for # spec_driven_development . Write the spec; Claude Run does the rest. # ai # automation # claude # claude_code # git # code # vibe # vibe_coding https:// dev.a8n.run/psa-systems/claude -run
